simple.meaning: מִכְתָּם (miktâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “an engraving , i.e. (techn.) a poem.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִכְתָּם (H4387) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 16:1, with occurrences in Psalms.

occurrences.englishText: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up.
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me,
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones?
Deliver me from my enemies, my God.
